architecture.mechanism: A high-profile-sensor-based relay circuit that alerts the driver in a front-collision situation and applies the brake automatically only in an emergency or critical situation.
architecture.intervention: Replace the single contamination-prone forward sensor path with a high-reliability ("high profile") sensor suite feeding a relay-circuit confirmation stage, so that braking is actuated only when the confirmed emergency criteria are met, with a driver-alert stage preceding automatic actuation.
architecture.expected_effect: Contaminant-induced false emergency braking in inclement weather is reduced, because a contaminated sensor's raw signal alone no longer directly triggers braking without relay-circuit confirmation of a genuine collision situation.
architecture.falsification_test: In controlled inclement-weather testing, apply rain, mud, or spray contamination to the forward sensor while driving at speed and record whether the AEB actuates braking without a real obstacle; any false braking event falsifies the mechanism's effectiveness.
